decisions.decision: The council members (as printed) agreed to the Town Manager's request for approval of $300,000 for the roof replacement.
decisions.quote: the council members agreed and heather added that the roof is getting worse

decisions.decision: Mr. Blatt will work with Mr. Jeffreys on the Town Meeting presentation.
decisions.quote: mr blatt would work with mr jeffreys on the presentation.

decisions.decision: The presentation will set out the work between now and spring to identify cost and timeline.
decisions.quote: we should put in the presentation what we are working on between now and the spring to identify cost and timeline

decisions.decision: The committee will use some of the ARPPA funds to begin a cost estimation.
decisions.quote: we have some good language and will use some of the arppa funds to get a cost estimation going.

decisions.decision: The committee will make award at its first meeting in January.
decisions.quote: we will make award at our first meeting in january and have all the numbers in the early part of the spring

decisions.decision: The committee will partner with the school committee on what is needed to shore up Turkey Hill, and a capital planning study of Turkey Hill was requested.
decisions.quote: we are partnering with the school committee to work on what is needed to shore up turkey hill.

decisions.decision: The committee will meet on the 21st (week of Thanksgiving) to discuss RFP language, then on Monday, November 20, and on the 4th and 18th of December.
decisions.quote: we are meeting again on the 21st, the week of thanksgiving to talk about rfp language in detail
